name: Block Party
css:
/* Block Party: a little toy-brick house on a studded baseplate (original 3D illustration, generic bricks, no logos). Threads are colored bricks with studs along the top, replies are plates, and a row of studs over the composer lights up as the context fills; the brick you are working in bounces while the agent works. Light only. */
 :root{--t3-radius-composer: 8px;--t3-radius-bubble: 6px;--t3-radius-card: 5px;--t3-radius-control: 5px;--t3-composer-outline: transparent;--bp-red: #d7322b;--bp-yellow: #f6c624;--bp-blue: #1f6fd1;--bp-green: #2f9e44;--bp-ink: #1e2430;--bp-round: ui-rounded,"SF Pro Rounded","Avenir Next",system-ui,sans-serif;--bp-studs: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,rgb(255 255 255 / 0.45) 0 2px,transparent 2.5px),radial-gradient(circle,rgb(0 0 0 / 0.0) 0 4.5px,rgb(0 0 0 / 0.22) 5px 5.5px,transparent 6px)}[data-t3-part="app-shell"]{isolation: isolate;accent-color: var(--bp-blue);background: linear-gradient(180deg,#92d4fb,#bfe9fd 60%,#d8f2fe)}[data-t3-part="app-shell"]::after{content: "";position: fixed;z-index: -2;left: 0;right: 0;bottom: 0;height: 15vh;background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,rgb(255 255 255 / 0.3) 0 2px,#45b053 3px 6px,#23802f 6.5px 7.5px,transparent 8px) 0 0 / 22px 18px,linear-gradient(180deg,#3aa548,#2f9440);-webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#000 30%);mask-image: linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#000 30%);pointer-events: none}[data-t3-part="app-shell"]::before{content: "";position: fixed;z-index: -1;right: 0;bottom: 0;height: max(260px,min(56vh,calc((50vw - 496px) * 2.4)));aspect-ratio: 1942 / 809;background: var(--t3-asset-art) center / 100% 100% no-repeat;-webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 30%),linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#000 18%);mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 30%),linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#000 18%);-webkit-mask-composite: source-in;mask-composite: intersect;pointer-events: none}[data-t3-part="main"]{--app-theme-canvas: transparent}[data-t3-part="sidebar"]{--app-theme-sidebar: transparent;background: radial-gradient(circle,transparent 0 4.5px,rgb(0 0 0 / 0.06) 5px 5.5px,transparent 6px) 0 0 / 16px 16px,#eceff3;border-right: 1px solid #c3cad3}.sidebar-stage-backdrop{display: none}[data-t3-part="sidebar-header"]{background: #f7f8fa;box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #d5dae1}[data-t3-part="sidebar-header"] a>span{color: var(--bp-red)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-header"] a>span>span{font: 800 20px/1 var(--bp-round);color: var(--bp-ink)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-header"] a>span::after{content: "";width: 22px;height: 12px;margin-left: 8px;border-radius: 2px;background: var(--bp-studs) 0 -2px / 11px 11px,var(--bp-yellow);box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18);display: inline-block}[data-t3-part="sidebar-search"]{background: #fff;box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #c3cad3}[data-t3-part="sidebar-toolbar"] button{color: var(--bp-ink);background: #fff;box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #c3cad3}[data-t3-part="sidebar-toolbar"] button:hover{background: #f1f3f6}[data-t3-part="thread-item"]{--bp-c: var(--bp-red);--bp-fg: #fff;--bp-sub: #ffd9d6}[data-t3-part="thread-item"]:nth-child(5n + 2){--bp-c: var(--bp-yellow);--bp-fg: #3a2c00;--bp-sub: #6e5600}[data-t3-part="thread-item"]:nth-child(5n + 3){--bp-c: var(--bp-blue);--bp-fg: #fff;--bp-sub: #d4e5ff}[data-t3-part="thread-item"]:nth-child(5n + 4){--bp-c: var(--bp-green);--bp-fg: #fff;--bp-sub: #d6f5dc}[data-t3-part="thread-item"]:nth-child(5n + 5){--bp-c: #f7f8fa;--bp-fg: var(--bp-ink);--bp-sub: #5d6675}[data-t3-part="thread-row"]{background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5) 0 1.5px,transparent 2px) 0 4px / 20px 10px,radial-gradient(circle,transparent 0 4px,rgb(0 0 0 / 0.2) 4.5px 5px,transparent 5.5px) 0 4px / 20px 10px,linear-gradient(180deg,rgb(255 255 255 / 0.18),transparent 40%),var(--bp-c);background-repeat: space no-repeat,space no-repeat,no-repeat,no-repeat;box-shadow: inset 0 -4px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.2),inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1),0 3px 6px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4);color: var(--bp-fg)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"]:hover{filter: brightness(1.05)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"],[data-t3-part="user-message-bubble"],[data-t3-part="assistant-message"]:has(.chat-markdown){background-origin: border-box}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][data-t3-variant="card"] [data-t3-part="thread-body"]{height: auto;padding-block: 15px 12px}[data-t3-part="thread-title"]{white-space: normal;overflow: visible;text-overflow: clip;font: 800 14.5px/1.3 var(--bp-round);color: var(--bp-fg)}[data-t3-part="project-name"],[data-t3-part="thread-status"],[data-t3-part="thread-meta"],[data-t3-part="thread-status"] *,[data-t3-part="thread-meta"] *{color: var(--bp-sub);font-weight: 700}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][aria-current="page"]{box-shadow: inset 0 -4px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.2),inset 0 0 0 3px var(--bp-ink),0 6px 10px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][data-t3-agent="waiting"]{outline: 3px dashed var(--bp-ink);outline-offset: 2px}[data-t3-part="sidebar-section-header"],[data-t3-part="sidebar-section-header"] *{font-family: var(--bp-round);font-weight: 800;color: var(--bp-ink) !important}[data-t3-part="sidebar-footer"]{background: #f7f8fa;box-shadow: 0 -2px 0 #d5dae1}[data-t3-part="chat-header"]{background: rgb(247 248 250 / 0.92);box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #d5dae1}[data-t3-part="chat-header"] nav li:last-child h2 span{font: 800 16px/1.2 var(--bp-round);color: var(--bp-ink)}[data-t3-part="user-message-bubble"]{background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5) 0 1.5px,transparent 2px) 0 4px / 20px 10px,radial-gradient(circle,transparent 0 4px,rgb(0 0 0 / 0.22) 4.5px 5px,transparent 5.5px) 0 4px / 20px 10px,var(--bp-blue);background-repeat: space no-repeat,space no-repeat,no-repeat;color: #fff;border: 0;padding-top: 18px;box-shadow: inset 0 -4px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.22),0 6px 10px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4);font-weight: 600}[data-t3-part="user-message-bubble"] *{color: inherit}[data-t3-part="assistant-message"]:has(.chat-markdown){background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,rgb(255 255 255 / 0.9) 0 1.5px,transparent 2px) 0 4px / 20px 10px,radial-gradient(circle,transparent 0 4px,rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12) 4.5px 5px,transparent 5.5px) 0 5px / 20px 10px,#fbfcfd;background-repeat: space no-repeat,space no-repeat,no-repeat;border-radius: var(--t3-radius-card);padding: 24px 22px 12px;box-shadow: inset 0 -5px 0 #d5dae1,inset 0 0 0 1px #d5dae1,0 10px 18px -8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35);color: var(--bp-ink)}[data-t3-part="assistant-message"] :not(pre)>code{background: #fff4c4;border-color: #f0d36a;color: #6e4c00}[data-t3-part="composer-surface"]{position: relative;background: #fbfcfd;box-shadow: inset 0 -5px 0 #d5dae1,inset 0 0 0 2px #c3cad3,0 12px 22px -10px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4)}[data-t3-part="composer-surface"]::before{content: "";position: absolute;z-index: 21;left: 20px;right: 20px;top: -6px;height: 12px;background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,rgb(255 255 255 / 0.6) 0 1.5px,var(--bp-yellow) 2px 4.5px,#b8900f 5px 5.5px,transparent 6px) 0 0 / 16px 12px repeat-x;clip-path: inset(0 calc((1 - var(--t3-context-used,0)) * 100%) 0 0);pointer-events: none}[data-t3-part="composer-context"]{background: #eef1f4;box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #c3cad3}[data-t3-part="composer-toolbar"] button[aria-label="Submit message"]{background: var(--bp-red);color: #fff;box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.22)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-content"],[data-t3-part="transcript"]{scrollbar-color: #9aa3af transparent}@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference){[data-t3-part="thread-row"][data-t3-agent="working"]{animation: bp-bounce 0.9s ease-in-out infinite}[data-t3-part="chat"][data-t3-agent="working"] [data-t3-part="composer-surface"]::before{animation: bp-glow 1.2s ease-in-out infinite}}@keyframes bp-bounce{50%{transform: translateY(-3px)}}@keyframes bp-glow{50%{opacity: 0.6}}
